preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(n) <= 3 and n.isdigit() and int(n) >= 1 and int(n) <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line contains a positive integer n representing the length of the interview.
The second line contains the string s of length n, consisting of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all('ogo' not in s[i:i+3] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: All occurrences of 'ogo' have been replaced with '***'.
